blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Robinsons Land Corp. (RLC) brought the magic of a Filipino Christmas to Bridgetowne Destination Estate in Pasig City on Friday, with festive dance performances and musical medleys. With the theme “Sama-Samang Magniningning,” the celebration put the spotlight on what makes Christmas in the Philippines special—the joy of coming together and the traditions that […]...
